blurb: Beyond The Boogie Dance Company offers dance instruction in Ballet, Tap, Jazz, Lyrical, Hip Hop, Acrobatics, and Step for students from 6 months old through adults. Classes focus on building technique, confidence, and proficiency in various dance disciplines. Studio rentals are available by the hour with set up and break down time included.
extraNote: Full payment required to hold rental date · Cancellations and rescheduled rentals must be made 24 hours before rental · Class registration closes 2 hours before class start time
